task_completion.description: Agent navigates to the FAQ module within Vtiger CRM.

task_completion.description: First FAQ entry regarding cancellation policy is created with correct details.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A form or detail view showing the question 'What is the cancellation policy for flight bookings?', Category 'General', Status 'Published', and the specific refund/fee details in the answer field.

task_completion.description: Third FAQ entry regarding baggage allowance is created with correct details.

integrity.description: The agent used the CRM graphical user interface rather than database manipulation or terminal commands.

integrity.description: The agent manually entered or pasted the data into the CRM fields rather than bypassing the UI.
integrity.visual_evidence: The FAQ creation forms are seen being filled out and saved within the browser environment.

integrity.description: The agent used the specific text provided in the prompt rather than 'lorem ipsum' or test strings.
integrity.visual_evidence: The text in the 'Answer' fields matches the specific policy details (e.g., '$150 fee', '6 months', '23 kg') provided in the task description.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must create three specific FAQ entries. All three must have Category set to 'General' and Status set to 'Published'. FAQ 1 must mention '24 hours' and '$150/$250' fees. FAQ 2 must mention '6 months' validity. FAQ 3 must mention '23 kg' and '$35/$75' fees. Verification should confirm these fields are saved in the Vtiger CRM interface.
